set.body: Evidence: full sums measured 0.069x-0.097x NumPy and axis sums 0.229x-0.329x. The public contract requires logical row-major blocks of 128 and bit-stable results across contiguous and strided views. Preserve that schedule while adding monomorphic contiguous-block, inner-stride, and axis-fiber loops; keep the general layout fallback; avoid per-element layout counters when a simpler path applies; and measure scratch arrays separately from output allocation. Acceptance: existing bit-level schedule tests plus adversarial differential laws pass on JVM and Scala.js; each optimized case is within 1.25x its raw exact-schedule control; full sums reach at least 0.25x NumPy and axis sums at least 0.50x at both sizes, or the closeout records a lower-bound-proven numerical-contract tax; no change to NaN, empty, overflow, widening, or arg-reduction semantics.
